mistake_reason: Despite FileSurfer and Assistant repeatedly providing correct averages from the attached PDF showing Hotels have the highest average rating, Orchestrator ignored these agents' inputs and decided to base the conclusion on non-specific external trends indicated by WebSurfer. This disregard of valid internal analysis and corrective feedback led to selecting 'Vacation rentals' instead of the correct 'Hotels', matching the error type FM-2.5 (Ignored Other Agent's Input).
